text:
alex: Heads-up — infra stand keeps growing, can we shift the weekly triage from Tue 11am to Wed 10am? I think it'll reduce context switching for infra/serving folks.

maria: Wed 10 works for me. would prefer keeping it 30m though.

sam: I'd rather keep Tue if possible, but ok with Wed if others need it.

jess: I'm +1 to shorten. 30m feels enough if we tighten agenda.

alex: Proposal then: move to Wed 10, 30m slot. Tight agenda: backlog quick hits, bug queue prioritization, owner assignment, and any urgent RFC reviews (only if >5m).

alex: Draft agenda snippet (copyable):
```
- 5m: quick status + blockers (each owner 30s)
- 10m: bug queue prioritization (top 3)
- 8m: owner/assignment updates + confirm owners
- 7m: RFC/design quick-checks (only items flagged as urgent)
```

patrick: I can update the calendar and invite people if we agree. also can add a rotating note to ping owners before the meeting.

oncall-bot: Reminder: upcoming triage change requires updating the on-call rotation notice (if calendar changed, update #incidents link).

maria: Small tweak — make the bug queue slot 12m and owner updates 6m? we've been spending too long on ownership confusion.

alex: OK adjusting: 5/8/12/5 (status/bug/owners/RFC). that gives 30m. sound good?

sam: fine with that split. will try to be concise.

jess: can we add a pinned checklist in the meeting doc: "bring triage PR IDs, owner to confirm, severity"? saves time.

patrick: I'll add the checklist to the doc and attach it to the calendar event. also adding a short pre-meeting note: "owners, please update status card 24h before".

maria: :thumbsup: thanks.

alex: Cool — final plan: move to Wed 10am, 30m, agenda and checklist updated. Patrick to update calendar + doc. Let's run this for 2 weeks and re-evaluate.

sam: works. thanks for consolidating.

patrick: Done — calendar updated, doc pinned. I also added a quick Google form to capture items for RFC quick-checks so we can filter urgent ones ahead of time: https://forms.g/triage-rfc (mock link).

jess: nice, that should cut down surprises.

alex: Thanks everyone — we'll monitor timebox and tweak after two runs. If anyone can't make Wed 10, post here and we'll rotate.
